summaries.summary: Members and leaders of the CJP (Citizens for Justice and Peace) have faced preventive arrest as protests continue in Delhi, with legal actions being taken against police conduct during these demonstrations.

Microsoft has introduced new hardware and updates for its Surface Laptop and AI technologies, while ongoing acquisitions and innovations in AI and machine learning are highlighted by companies like Apple and Cloudflare.
The international community has condemned a Houthi missile attack on Riyadh airport, which resulted in several casualties and extensive damage.
